lines.text: Gerdur gave in once, reluctantly, when {player} asked her for intimate help; she is embarrassed and keeps it from her husband Hod.
Gerdur has been intimate with {player} more than once, each time swearing it was the last; she keeps it secret from her husband Hod.
Gerdur is in an ongoing secret affair with {player} behind her husband Hod's back, takes risks for it and is jealous of Sigrid.
